reason: Amendment pass on task 5565 (reviewer suggestions 1 and 6), net-additive: the startup shrink diagnostic now WARNs only for over-cap lanes that may still hold an assignment (durable record ASSIGNED/IN_USE or missing) and names drained ones at INFO, so the warning clears once a shrink drains -- one extra branch in GitOps.warn_on_warm_lane_pool_shrink plus the OverCapLane.may_hold_assignment predicate. The over-cap index rule now lives in one helper, WarmLanePool._over_cap_index, used by both canonical_lane and over_cap_report; it replaces _over_cap_slot and the test-only is_over_cap, so canonical_lane rises 1->2 while those two removals offset it at file level.
